authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 sections 20.1, 20.4.59, 20.4.61, 20.4.63, 20.4.67 and 20.4.69
scope: VIEW, UCS, VPORT, DIMSTYLE and viewport-entity control frames in the generated AC1012 pair.
checks: Both drawings' five CRC-checked control frames have exact data/handle boundaries, no EED or reactors and typed null owner/extension. VIEW, UCS and viewport-entity controls are empty; VPORT and DIMSTYLE each have one role-2 entry, respectively 0x26 and 0x2D.

The observer rejects every byte-prefix truncation and wrong-role mutation and passes the unchanged frame on retry. Adapter readback contains the expected VPORT and DIMSTYLE identities, names and control owners; the two input checks and shared vector CTest pass.

Independent cadkit-dwg 0.5.4 decodes the selected VPORT and DIMSTYLE control entries with no unconsumed bits; it labels R13 untested. The updated handoff packet includes all five control frame hashes. No drawing fixture was committed.
limits: The active VPORT and DIMSTYLE body layouts remain separately unqualified by this control-only evidence. Native normal-open, cloning behavior, whole-file graph closure and output support remain open.
